payroll.title: Payroll · {{month}}
payroll.subtitle: One salary sheet per payslip company · worked out by the server from attendance, salary, allowances and advances · overtime at ×{{ot}} (Settings)
payroll.noRight: The Payroll right is needed to see and run payroll. Ask Admin.
payroll.noCompany: No company to run payroll for yet.
payroll.prepared: Payroll prepared. Another person with the Payroll right approves it.
payroll.approved: Payroll approved and posted to the books. Payslip-ready messages are queued (no amounts).
payroll.emptyBody: Mark attendance first, then press Prepare payroll. You can prepare again until it is approved.
payroll.youPrepared: You prepared this sheet, so another person with the Payroll right must approve it.
payroll.otherPrepared: Prepared by someone else — you may approve it after checking.
payroll.postedAs: Posted to the books as {{no}} dated {{date}}.
payroll.pfEsi: PF and ESI are off until the CA confirms the rates in Settings.
payroll.monthlyRule: Basic = salary × payable days ÷ days in the month
payroll.noneInGroup: No one on monthly salary in this run.
payroll.confirmEffect: Posts ₹{{net}} to pay for {{people}} people to the books, recovers advances, locks the month's attendance and queues payslip-ready messages. It cannot be edited after this.
